items.title: Announcements by Chair, Commissioners and Secretary
Minutes from the February 26, 2026 Meeting of the Public Works Commission
Powell Street Improvement Project Engineering Professional Services – Sole Source Contract Award
items.text: Powell Street Improvement Project Engineering Professional Services – Sole Source Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award sole-source professional engineering services contract for the Powell Street Improvement Project to Field Operations, LLC, in an amount not to exceed $5,000,000 for a contract duration of 1,080 calendar days, subject to the approval of the Civil Service Commission.

items.title: As-Needed Specification Writing Services No. 4, Contract ID 1000032085 – Contract Modification
items.text: As-Needed Specification Writing Services No. 4, Contract ID 1000032085 – Contract Modification Staff Recommendation: Approve modification to As-Needed Specification Writing Services No. 4, Contract ID 1000032085 with Emily Borland Specifications, Inc. to increase the not-to-exceed contract amount by $400,000 for a new not-to- exceed amount of $1,200,000.
